notes.title: New CLIMB mode!
notes.content:
You can now unlock new levels by playing Climb Mode! Climb mode lets you climb at your own pace without any time limits!

Speed mode, where you try to get the Gold time record, is now available as an alternative gameplay mode for those who want an extra challenge.

notes.title: Camera Modes!
notes.content:
NEW Camera modes! You can press Tab or Right Thumbstick to change camera modes from Free, to Follow. You can also change camera from the Options screen. 

Additionally, you can now use the Mouse to control the cameras - move it around to look, and use the Scroll wheel to zoom in and out.
